text: Appeal of Order to Comply (March 14, 2019) for 1601 Birchmount Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (March 14, 2019) for 1601 Birchmount Road, Folder No. 19 125435 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to July 15, 2019, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
